pick.name: Skydo
pick.what: Local USD/EUR/GBP collection accounts for Indian exporters, INR in ~1 business day, free FIRA
pick.why: Flat fee + 0% FX markup beats % fees on consulting-size invoices; RBI PA-CB final authorisation (inward) Jan 2026
pick.free_limits: $19 up to $2,000; $29 $2,001-$10,000; 0.3% above $10,000; 0% FX markup; free per-transaction FIRA; no inactivity fee (Skydo's own pages; one page conflicts $19/$29). PA-CB rules cap Rs25 lakh per transaction.

alts.name: Razorpay International Bank Transfer (MCA)
alts.why: Cheaper than Skydo below ~$1,600 per invoice; same vendor as INR PG
alts.free_limits: 1% per transaction + GST, 0% FX markup, FIRC/eFIRC included; requires domestic activation

alts.name: Wise Business (India)
alts.what: Receive via local account details, auto-convert to INR
alts.why: Freelancer/sole-trader type allowed (no company); familiar to foreign clients
alts.free_limits: Receiving is business-accounts only (freelancer type OK with Aadhaar+PAN video KYC, physically in India, no VPN); 18% GST on fees; third-party: ~$6.11 per USD SWIFT receipt, ~1.5-1.7% conversion, ~$2.50 e-FIRA

candidates.name: Razorpay MCA
candidates.verdict: Alt: 1% + GST, cheaper for small invoices

candidates.name: Payoneer
candidates.verdict: 1% ACH / 3.2% + $0.49 card + 2-3% FX on withdrawal, $29.95/yr if < $6k received (competitor-sourced)

candidates.name: PayPal
candidates.verdict: Worst: 4.4% + $0.30 + 3% conversion spread (official India fee page)

candidates.name: Direct SWIFT to bank
candidates.verdict: Bank FX margin + intermediary fees; eBRC from bank

decision: Cost per invoice: $1,000 -> Razorpay ~$11.8, Skydo $19, Wise ~$22; $5,000 -> Skydo $29, Razorpay ~$59, Wise ~$86 (third-party Wise rates). Pick Skydo for typical consulting invoices; route small invoices through Razorpay MCA if you already use Razorpay.
details: Use purpose code P0802 (software consultancy) or P0807 (off-site software exports) as appropriate. Export proceeds must be realised within 15 months (Nov 2025 amendment per secondary source; verify).

verify.note: RBI Master Direction on Regulation of Payment Aggregators (15 Sep 2025, rbi.org.in id=12896) caps PA-CB inward/outward transactions at Rs25 lakh PER TRANSACTION (the 2023 circular said per unit of goods/services). The cap is confirmed from RBI; it excludes card-network-settled card payments. Skydo's final PA-CB authorisation (~9 Jan 2026) is reported by the PTI wire (The Week, Entrackr, YourStory), not an RBI page; RBI's PA list was not fetched. Skydo's fee slabs ($19 < $2,000; $29 $2,001-10,000; 0.3% above; 0% FX; free FIRA) are consistent across Skydo's own pages, but skydo.com/pricing returns 404. Razorpay MCA: '1% with Zero Forex Markup', FIRC included; GST not required and individuals appear eligible (Video KYC, purpose code). The source_url should be primary.
